verdict.rationale: The Trello REST API reference lists a "Batch" section (trello-docs-21), which suggests some programmatic batching. Board buttons that trigger automation (trello-docs-11) and generic workflow automation (trello-docs-3) hint at multi-item actions, but nothing shows they operate across many cards at once. The evidence is only a navigation-level mention, with no description of what the Batch endpoint can do or of any in-UI or AI-driven bulk editing. missing for 10: documentation of Batch endpoint scope (reads vs. writes, limits), bulk card edit/move/archive in the UI or automation, bulk actions via the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
